headline: Cal State San Bernardino carries the conference into December
dek: Cal State San Bernardino is the lone CCAA program left on the schedule after drawing Cal State LA, with a trip to Charleston ahead. It has fifteen wins and a conference-high 44 goals, while unbeaten Cal State LA has no match remaining.
displaced_by: Cal State San Bernardino drew Cal State LA and is now the only side with a match left

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Fresno Pacific has scored 37 goals and conceded 27, yet ten losses outpace its seven wins and one draw: scoring freely has not turned into results.

wire.line: Cal State LA has conceded seven goals across nineteen wins and three draws without a defeat.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Ten matches have passed their date with no result recorded; the latest, and the only meeting between conference sides, is Cal Poly Pomona's home match with Fresno Pacific.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Cal State East Bay has conceded 52 goals, more than any other program in the conference.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Stanislaus State has recorded seven draws, more than any other program in the conference.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Cisco Avila has scored twelve of Cal State San Marcos's 40 goals.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Donovan Palomares has kept eight shutouts in goal for Cal State San Bernardino.

last_match.line: Cal State LA has yet to lose a match this season; Cal State San Bernardino has not lost since their previous meeting.

next_match.line: Cal State San Bernardino enters as the conference's highest-scoring side and its last remaining team.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
